links.comparator_used: CNN+Grad-CAM+multimodal LLM baseline without the injected ECG Interpretation Guide
links.outcome: Semantic quality of generated ECG impressions (BERTScore against reference reports) and perceived consistency
links.effect: Average BERTScore of generated impressions increased from 0.818 to 0.953; classification performance remained competitive
links.quote: In particular, our method increases the average BERTScore of generated impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 relative to a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, indicat- ing closer alignment with reference reports.
